title: Father with Son and Daughter, 1950s B&W Snapshot USA
description: A black-and-white vintage snapshot from around 1950 depicting a father standing affectionately with his young son and daughter outside in a narrow alleyway between two clapboard-sided houses. The father wears a light collared shirt and high-waisted trousers, while his son wears a striped shirt with a belt, and his daughter wears a light ruffled dress. The print features scalloped deckled edges typical of mid-20th-century family photo finishing.
